body:
Runner trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-10-30, B' 7f964cd8 Phase B on Windows B): two FALSE STOPs from my own count checks on legs that had passed. (1) vitest colours its summary: "Tests  178 passed (178)" is wrapped in ANSI escapes, so grep -E 'Tests +178 passed \(178\)' on focused.log missed it. (2) Node's test runner (spec reporter under the launcher) prints "ℹ pass 21"; in Git Bash's C locale, a bracket expression like [#ℹ] matches a single byte, so it never matched the multibyte ℹ.
Rule: judge counts from the launcher's own ASCII stdout line `tests: passed=N failed=M ignored=K` (printed after RUN/PASS) together with the exit code; if reading focused.log, first strip ANSI (sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g') and avoid non-ASCII in bracket expressions. When a check stops a passed leg, verify the verdict from the run's own summary, disclose it, and run only the legs that never started; never rerun the passed one.
